title: 第7章 击败我第8章 白家压迫
content_zh:
第7章击败我美、太美了！
如蝉翼般的轻纱紧贴着娇躯，将一具完美无瑕的身材勾勒得淋漓尽致。
似白雪般的肌肤透发着一抹令人心动的潮红，再配上那倾城的容颜，这一幕绝对充满了诱惑力。
“我、我感到不对劲。”
白念冰惊慌的声音让萧沉瞬间回过神来，心中暗骂自己定力还是不够。
“有什么问题吗？”
萧沉走进浴桶，眼神却没有落在白念冰的身上，而是刻意回避她的身体。
“我的血液温度在提高，似乎要超过我的承受能力了，我不知道该不该继续。”
白念冰给萧沉的感觉一直很沉稳，但此刻却极度慌乱，体内似有恐怖的力量在翻腾，让她甚至顾不上男女之别，任由自己的身体暴露在萧沉眼中。
凌子桓若是得知此事，必然会抓狂到吐血。
萧沉皱起了眉头，毒皇的记忆里，可没有这种情形。
“你先出来。”
萧沉开口的刹那，白念冰这才想起自己怕影响药效吸收，只穿了最轻薄的纱衣。
她也终于意识到，自己的身体，在对方眼里，已经没有秘密了。
白念冰低着头，想装作什么事都没发生过，可她刚把外衣披上，血液中的狂暴力量便仿佛彻底失控般，冲击着她的五脏六腑，让她当即喷出一口鲜血来。
萧沉立即扶住了即将跌倒的白念冰，那柔软的感觉让他心神一荡。
不过，他可没有心情细细品味，而是迅速捏住了白念冰的手腕，为她搭脉。
“是我疏忽了！”
萧沉神色闪烁了下。
“我会死吗？”

白念冰望向萧沉，她仿佛要被体内的那股力量撕碎，那是怎样的剧毒？
“有我在，不会让你死的。”
萧沉看似简单的一句话，却让白念冰心中一动，美眸之中流露出异样的神采。
“冒犯了。”
萧沉淡淡吐出一道声音，旋即双指并拢，在白念冰后背数道大穴上迅速点落。
“你的境界，是苦海境六重，而这药效，是针对苦海九重强者的，故而其中蕴藏的力量过于凶猛霸道，让你难以承受，并非剧毒。
我现在为你疏通筋脉，让这股力量汇聚到你的苦海，你尝试着运转功法吸收。”
随着后背数道大穴被萧沉打通，白念冰顿时觉得身体舒缓了不少，甚至，体内流淌着一股暖意，真元运行都变得更加畅通了。
“还有……”
萧沉犹豫片刻，还是手指击出，还有几处穴位，在正面。
白念冰的脸色更红了，虽说萧沉没有点在重要的部位上，可她这十几年来，还没有被男子触碰过身体。
想到先前的情形，白念冰的脸和身体都开始发烫。
“怎么回事，体温降不下去吗？”
萧沉感知力敏锐，察觉到白念冰的温度又有所升高，不禁有些诧异。
“不不不，是我自己的问题，我运功调息一下。”
白念冰急忙开口。
萧沉仿佛也明白了什么，转过头，开口道，“你先运功，好了叫我。”
说罢，萧沉迈步离开了房间。
白念冰长舒了一口气，那股紧张羞涩之意退去不少，这时，她猛然想到一个问题。
“他先前点我穴位，推动药力流转，似乎，动用了真元力量！”

以她的聪慧，瞬间想到了许多，“这么看来，他并没有被废去修为，或者说，没有被完全废去……”
不过，白念冰也没有多想，努力稳住心神，开始运转功法，吸纳那股霸道的药效。
content_en:
Chapter 7 Defeat Me is beautiful, so beautiful!
The gauze like cicada wings clings to the delicate body, vividly outlining a flawless figure.
The snow-like skin has a heart-warming flush, and coupled with that alluring face, this scene is absolutely full of temptation.
"I-I feel something is wrong."
Bai Nianbing's panicked voice made Xiao Chen come back to his senses instantly, cursing in his heart that he still didn't have enough concentration.
"Any questions?"
Xiao Chen walked into the bathtub, but his eyes did not fall on Bai Nianbing, but deliberately avoided her body.
"My blood temperature is rising and it seems to be more than I can bear. I don't know if I should continue."
Bai Nianbing had always felt calm to Xiao Chen, but at this moment she was extremely flustered. There seemed to be terrifying power surging in her body, making her not even care about the difference between men and women, and allowed her body to be exposed to Xiao Chen's eyes.
If Ling Zihuan learned about this, he would definitely go crazy and vomit blood.
Xiao Chen frowned. There was no such situation in the Poison Emperor's memory.
"You come out first."
The moment Xiao Chen spoke, Bai Nianbing remembered that he was afraid of affecting the absorption of the medicine, so he only wore the lightest gauze.
She finally realized that her body had no secrets in the eyes of the other party.
Bai Nianbing lowered her head, trying to pretend that nothing had happened, but as soon as she put on her coat, the violent force in her blood seemed to be completely out of control, impacting her internal organs, causing her to spit out a mouthful of blood immediately.
Xiao Chen immediately supported Bai Nianbing, who was about to fall, and the soft feeling made his heart tremble.
However, he was not in the mood to savor it carefully, but quickly pinched Bai Nianbing's wrist and took her pulse.
"I was negligent!"
Xiao Chen's expression flickered.
"Am I going to die?"
Bai Nianbing looked at Xiao Chen. She seemed to be torn apart by the power in her body. What kind of poison was that?
"As long as I'm here, I won't let you die."
Xiao Chen's seemingly simple words made Bai Nianbing's heart move, and a strange look appeared in his beautiful eyes.
"Offended."
Xiao Chen made a faint sound, then put his fingers together and quickly tapped several large acupuncture points on Bai Nianbing's back.
"Your realm is the sixth level of the Sea of Bitter Realm, and the effect of this medicine is aimed at the strong people of the ninth level of the Sea of Bitterness. Therefore, the power contained in it is too fierce and overbearing for you to bear, and it is not highly poisonous.
I will now clear your tendons and let this power gather into your sea of suffering, and you try to use the exercises to absorb it. "
As several large acupuncture points on his back were opened by Xiao Chen, Bai Nianbing immediately felt that his body relaxed a lot. There was even a warmth flowing in his body, and the movement of his true energy became smoother.
"And..."
Xiao Chen hesitated for a moment, and then struck out with his finger. There were still several acupuncture points on the front.
Bai Nianbing's face turned even redder. Although Xiao Chen did not touch any important parts, she had not been touched by a man in the past ten years.
Thinking of the previous situation, Bai Nianbing's face and body began to feel hot.
"What's going on? Can't your temperature come down?"
Xiao Chen's perception was sharp and he could not help but feel a little surprised when he noticed that Bai Nianbing's temperature had increased again.
"No, no, no, it's my own problem. I'll do some exercise and adjust my breathing."
Bai Nianbing spoke hurriedly.
Xiao Chen seemed to understand something, turned his head and said, "You need to practice your skills first, then call me."
After that, Xiao Chen stepped out of the room.
Bai Nianbing breathed a long sigh of relief, and her nervousness and shyness receded a lot. At this time, she suddenly thought of a question.
"He tapped my acupuncture points earlier to promote the flow of medicine. It seems that he used the power of true energy!"
With her intelligence, she thought of many things in an instant, "It seems that his cultivation has not been abolished, or in other words, he has not been completely abolished..."
However, Bai Nianbing didn't think too much. He tried to stabilize his mind and began to run his skills to absorb the overbearing medicinal effect.
